integrity.proof_type: complete finite enumeration with explicit equivalence between bitmask predicate and identifying-code definition
integrity.verification: two independently implemented exhaustive programs, with checked orbit representatives

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only length-three words on a fixed labeled ternary alphabet and closed radius-one neighborhoods in the undirected de Bruijn graph.
The 372 and 22 orbit counts use the explicitly stated natural action of S3 times reversal; no assertion is made about the full automorphism group.
The minimum nine for the unconstrained graph is previously known; the assessed contribution is its complete equality census and the exact reversal-invariance constraint.
Priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed earlier equivalent results.
title: Reversal symmetry costs two sensors on the ternary length-three de Bruijn network
